0x10253160.name: StAvatar_CheckBuffersReady
0x10253160.evidence: when bit 0 of the flags word is set and the index at +0x10 is nonnegative, clears the words at +4 and +8, asks the file manager (FUN_101C4A30) about the indices at +0xC and +0x10, and sets bit 0x10 on each positive answer
0x10253160.summary: Checks the two buffer indices against the file manager and marks the buffers ready.
